text:
alex: Quick sanity check — I kicked off a small canary for the fused+paged attention path on a3-16. Can someone run a NVTX trace + perf counters and confirm there's no tail-latency regression?

alex: Details: commit 4f8c2e7 (attn-fuse-refactor). Local quick run looked promising but noisy. Baseline (paged-only): median 8.3ms, p95 14.2ms. Fused+paged: median 6.9ms, p95 18.1ms (weird tail).

alex: Command I used:
```bash
./bench --model gpt2-paged --profile nvtx --iters 200 --batch 4 --seq 1024 --run fused_canary
```

morgan: I can run this on pool-r3 later today. Which machine size did you use? need exact commit + any env flags.

alex: used a3-16x with CUDA 12.1, cuDNN 9.0. Env: USE_FLASH=1, PAGE_CACHE=enabled. Commit 4f8c2e7.

jia: Can you also capture kv-cache metrics and the allocator stats? If tail is from KV eviction we should see patterns. NVTX + heap trace please. Example nvprof wrapper:
```bash
NVTX_ENABLE=1 TRACE_HEAP=1 ./bench ...
```

alex: adding those flags to the run now. Also uploaded my noisy log to https://go/run/1769990123-canary — contains perf csv and stdout.

ops-bot: Batch job queued: canary-run-1769990123 on pool-r3 (ETA 34m). Job id: job-88b3.

sam: Quick note — when you compare p95 please normalize for warm/cold start. We saw transient p95 spikes when prefix-caching warmed up. Also try --kv-cache-limit=4G for parity with production.

morgan: ack. I'll set kv-cache-limit=4G and run two back-to-back runs to compare warm vs steady. I won't be able to start until ~2pm PST.

anita: If you enable bfloat16 paths make sure to monitor memcpy stalls — last time bf16 + fused kernels showed a memcpy contention bump. Might need smaller batch to reproduce.

morgan: started run. capturing NVTX + heaptrace + thrpt counters. Will post results here in ~25m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

morgan: (results pasted)
```text
run: fused_canary commit 4f8c2e7 on a3-16
baseline (paged-only): median 8.4ms, p90 12.6ms, p95 14.0ms
fused+paged: median 6.8ms, p90 12.9ms, p95 17.9ms
notes: tail seems correlated with periodic kv-eviction events every ~150 requests. NVTX shows long memcpy spans (~2.1ms) during eviction. Heaptrace shows allocator churn at ~120MB/s.
```

alex: great data — suggests fusion wins median but eviction-induced memcpy increases p95. That matches suspicion. Next steps: add prefix caching backpressure in runtime and re-run.

jia: I can take the NVTX trace and annotate hotspots. Will open an issue with annotated screenshots.

alex: thanks @jia and @morgan. Can someone also link the canary artifacts to a short PR so we have perf baseline saved? I can draft the PR.

morgan: I'll upload artifacts from job-88b3 to the artifacts bucket and comment the link in the PR once it's up. :thumbsup:

anita: FYI, if we change eviction threshold we should run a quick charge test to ensure memory headroom doesn't breach on 32k sequences.

sam: volunteered to run a 32k smoke after the fix.

alex: plan sounds good. I'll open PR-# for the runtime change and assign @jia for trace review, @morgan for canary artifacts, and @sam for 32k smoke once merged. Thanks all. :rocket:
